  420006, 420016,  -- Daily Routines (rotina diária = intermediário)

  390004,          -- At the Restaurant
  390009,          -- Travel Adventures

);

  390008           -- Scientific Research (pesquisa científica = avançado)
);

  390006,          -- Business Meeting
  390007           -- Stock Market Basics
);
